summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of HoustonLab OS. 27/27 backend pytest tests PASSED covering auth, templates, clients, devices, jobs (CRUD + timeline/checklist/finance/secrets), uploads, dashboard, search, settings, profile. Frontend verified end-to-end: login → dashboard with KPIs + 6-month revenue chart, Jobs list with HL- codes, Job detail with all tabs, New Job page renders 12 template cards, Clients + Devices pages list seeded items, Finance page shows charts + outstanding/paid tables, Templates + Settings render correctly. Admin password preserved (change-password roundtrip verified).

minor.issue: Returns 403 instead of 401 when no Authorization header is sent (FastAPI HTTPBearer default). Functionally fine, but inconsistent with /api/auth/login which returns 401 for bad creds.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on mount — cosmetic console noise, chart renders correctly after layout settles.
A tooltip ('2025-11 revenue: 0') is shown immediately on page load even without hover — likely defaultIndex/initial activeTooltip state in recharts. Minor UX polish.

action_items: (Optional) Remove/guard initial Recharts tooltip display on Dashboard Revenue chart.
(Optional) Consider returning 401 (not 403) from get_current_user when Authorization header is missing for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Uploads route has no max file size limit — a large upload will buffer fully to disk; consider adding a size cap and/or streaming guard.
Reveal-secret uses a dict body (body: dict) instead of a Pydantic model; recommend a RevealPayload model for validation and OpenAPI docs.

auth_routes login: identifier is lowercased before matching, but users collection stores email from env as-is. Works here because seed uses lowercase admin/admin@houstonlab.local, but usernames/emails created in mixed case would fail to login. Recommend storing normalized (lower) email+username at creation.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event(startup/shutdown); migrate to lifespan context manager for FastAPI >=0.100.
CORS is configured with allow_origins=['*'] AND allow_credentials=True — this combination is ignored by browsers and violates CORS spec; use explicit origins when credentials are enabled.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all pages load, login flow works, 12 templates visible, 7 devices seeded, charts + tables render)

test_credentials: admin / ChangeMe123! (also admin@houstonlab.local) — restored after change-password roundtrip test.
seed_data_creation: No new persistent seed data. All test-created clients/devices/jobs/secrets/attachments were deleted in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend_test.py pytest suite is in /app/backend/tests/. Run with: pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Reveals follow pattern: password re-confirmation required. Uploads use multipart/form-data and serve at /api/files/<filename>. Jobs secrets list never returns decrypted value or encrypted_value — only id/label/created_at/masked. Dashboard monthly revenue array is always last 6 months (len=6). Admin password MUST stay ChangeMe123! — tests restore it.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Minor design polish items only.
